Line.DefaultText: He greets you with a steady gaze.
Line.Text: 他以沉稳的目光向你致意。
Line.zh: 他以沉稳的目光向你致意。
Line.en: He greets you with a steady gaze.
Line.ja: He greets you with a steady gaze.

Line.DefaultText: He says he's a trader specialized on metals and their products. He's happy to discuss metal quality and tool craftsmanship.
Line.Text: 他说自己是专营金属及其制品的商人。他很乐意讨论金属品质和工具工艺。
Line.zh: 他说自己是专营金属及其制品的商人。他很乐意讨论金属品质和工具工艺。
Line.en: He says he's a trader specialized on metals and their products. He's happy to discuss metal quality and tool craftsmanship.
Line.ja: He says he's a trader specialized on metals and their products. He's happy to discuss metal quality and tool craftsmanship.

Line.DefaultText: He says he will try to bring more tin on his next visit.
Line.Text: 他说下次来的时候会试着带更多的锡。
Line.zh: 他说下次来的时候会试着带更多的锡。
Line.en: He says he will try to bring more tin on his next visit.
Line.ja: He says he will try to bring more tin on his next visit.

Line.DefaultText:
He's interested in metal, ore, charcoal, flint and tools. 
Values metal and ore above all. 
Usually brings copper, tin and metal tools.
Line.Text: 他对金属、矿石、木炭、燧石和工具感兴趣。\n最看重金属和矿石。\n通常会带来铜、锡和金属工具。
Line.zh: 他对金属、矿石、木炭、燧石和工具感兴趣。\n最看重金属和矿石。\n通常会带来铜、锡和金属工具。
Line.en: He's interested in metal, ore, charcoal, flint and tools. \nValues metal and ore above all. \nUsually brings copper, tin and metal tools.
Line.ja:
He's interested in metal, ore, charcoal, flint and tools.
